verses.original: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְאָ֫סָ֥ף אֵ֤ל׀ אֱ‍ֽלֹהִ֡ים יְֽהוָ֗ה דִּבֶּ֥ר וַיִּקְרָא־ אָ֑רֶץ מִמִּזְרַח־ שֶׁ֝֗מֶשׁ עַד־ מְבֹאֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: miz·mō·wr lə·’ā·sāp̄ ’êl ’ĕlō·hîm Yah·weh dib·ber way·yiq·rā- ’ā·reṣ mim·miz·ra·ḥō·še- meš ‘aḏ- mə·ḇō·’ōw
verses.literal: A Psalm of Asaph The Mighty One God the LORD speaks and summons the earth from where the sun rises to where it sets . . .
verses.literalPt: O poderoso Deus, Jeová, fala e convoca a terra desde o nascer do sol até o seu ocaso.

verses.original: מִצִּיּ֥וֹן מִכְלַל־ יֹ֗פִי אֱלֹהִ֥ים הוֹפִֽיעַ׃
verses.transliteration: miṣ·ṣî·yō·wn miḵ·lal- yō·p̄î ’ĕ·lō·hîm hō·w·p̄î·a‘
verses.literal: From Zion perfect in beauty God shines forth
verses.literalPt: Desde Sião, perfeição de beleza, resplandece Deus.

verses.original: יָ֤בֹ֥א אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וְֽאַל־ יֶ֫חֱרַ֥שׁ אֵשׁ־ לְפָנָ֥יו תֹּאכֵ֑ל וּ֝סְבִיבָ֗יו נִשְׂעֲרָ֥ה מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: yā·ḇō ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū wə·’al- ye·ḥĕ·raš ’êš- lə·p̄ā·nāw tō·ḵêl ū·sə·ḇî·ḇāw niś·‘ă·rāh mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: Our God approaches and will not be silent Consuming fire precedes Him and a tempest . . . rages around Him
verses.literalPt: O nosso Deus vem e não fica em silêncio; arde, diante dele, um fogo, e, em redor, reina uma grande procela.

verses.original: יִקְרָ֣א אֶל־ הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם מֵעָ֑ל וְאֶל־ הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ לָדִ֥ין עַמּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: yiq·rā ’el- haš·šā·ma·yim mê·‘āl wə·’el- hā·’ā·reṣ lā·ḏîn ‘am·mōw
verses.literal: He summons . . . the heavens above . . . and the earth that He may judge His people
verses.literalPt: Ele intima os céus lá em cima e a terra, para o julgamento do seu povo.

verses.original: אִסְפוּ־ לִ֥י חֲסִידָ֑י כֹּרְתֵ֖י בְרִיתִ֣י עֲלֵי־ זָֽבַח׃
verses.transliteration: ’is·p̄ū- lî ḥă·sî·ḏāy kō·rə·ṯê ḇə·rî·ṯî ‘ă·lê- zā·ḇaḥ
verses.literal: Gather to Me My saints who made a covenant with Me by sacrifice
verses.literalPt: Reuni a mim os meus santos, os que comigo fazem aliança por meio de sacrifícios.

verses.original: וַיַּגִּ֣ידוּ שָׁמַ֣יִם צִדְק֑וֹ כִּֽי־ אֱלֹהִ֓ים׀ שֹׁפֵ֖ט ה֣וּא סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yag·gî·ḏū šā·ma·yim ṣiḏ·qōw kî- ’ĕ·lō·hîm šō·p̄êṭ hū se·lāh
verses.literal: And the heavens proclaim His righteousness for God Himself is Judge Selah
verses.literalPt: Os céus proclamam a retidão dele, porque é Deus mesmo quem vai julgar. (Selá)

verses.original: שִׁמְעָ֤ה עַמִּ֨י׀ וַאֲדַבֵּ֗רָה יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל וְאָעִ֣ידָה בָּ֑ךְ אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֱלֹהֶ֣יךָ אָנֹֽכִי׃
verses.transliteration: šim·‘āh ‘am·mî wa·’ă·ḏab·bê·rāh yiś·rā·’êl wə·’ā·‘î·ḏāh bāḵ ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ’ā·nō·ḵî
verses.literal: Hear O My people and I will speak O Israel and I will testify against you I am God your God
verses.literalPt: Ouve, povo meu, e eu falarei; Ó Israel, e eu te protestarei. Eu sou Deus, o teu Deus.

verses.original: לֹ֣א עַל־ זְ֭בָחֶיךָ אוֹכִיחֶ֑ךָ וְעוֹלֹתֶ֖יךָ לְנֶגְדִּ֣י תָמִֽיד׃
verses.transliteration: lō ‘al- zə·ḇā·ḥe·ḵā ’ō·w·ḵî·ḥe·ḵā wə·‘ō·w·lō·ṯe·ḵā lə·neḡ·dî ṯā·mîḏ
verses.literal: I do not rebuke you for your sacrifices and your burnt offerings are ever before Me
verses.literalPt: Não te arguirei de teus sacrifícios, nem de teus holocaustos, que estão sempre diante de mim.

verses.original: לֹא־ אֶקַּ֣ח מִבֵּיתְךָ֣ פָ֑ר מִ֝מִּכְלְאֹתֶ֗יךָ עַתּוּדִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: lō- ’eq·qaḥ mib·bê·ṯə·ḵā p̄ār mim·miḵ·lə·’ō·ṯe·ḵā ‘at·tū·ḏîm
verses.literal: I have no need for a bull from your stall or goats from your pens
verses.literalPt: Não tomarei da tua casa novilhos, nem dos teus apriscos, bodes.

verses.original: כִּי־ לִ֥י כָל־ חַיְתוֹ־ יָ֑עַר בְּ֝הֵמ֗וֹת בְּהַרְרֵי־ אָֽלֶף׃
verses.transliteration: kî- lî ḵāl ḥay·ṯōw- yā·‘ar bə·hê·mō·wṯ bə·har·rê- ’ā·lep̄
verses.literal: for every beast of the forest is Mine the cattle on a thousand hills
verses.literalPt: Pois meus são todos os animais do bosque, e os gados, sobre milhares de outeiros.

verses.original: יָ֭דַעְתִּי כָּל־ ע֣וֹף הָרִ֑ים וְזִ֥יז שָׂ֝דַ֗י עִמָּדִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: yā·ḏa‘·tî kāl- ‘ō·wp̄ hā·rîm wə·zîz śā·d̲ai ‘im·mā·ḏî
verses.literal: I know every bird in the mountains and the creatures of the field are Mine
verses.literalPt: Conheço todas as aves dos montes e tudo o que se move no campo, tenho-o presente.

verses.original: אִם־ אֶ֭רְעַב לֹא־ אֹ֣מַר לָ֑ךְ כִּי־ לִ֥י תֵ֝בֵ֗ל וּמְלֹאָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- ’er·‘aḇ lō- ’ō·mar lāḵ kî- lî ṯê·ḇêl ū·mə·lō·’āh
verses.literal: If I were hungry I would not tell you for the world is Mine and the fullness thereof
verses.literalPt: Se eu tivesse fome, não to diria a ti, pois meu é o mundo e a sua plenitude.

verses.original: הַֽ֭אוֹכַל בְּשַׂ֣ר אַבִּירִ֑ים וְדַ֖ם עַתּוּדִ֣ים אֶשְׁתֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ha·’ō·w·ḵal bə·śar ’ab·bî·rîm wə·ḏam ‘at·tū·ḏîm ’eš·teh
verses.literal: Do I eat the flesh of bulls or drink the blood of goats
verses.literalPt: Acaso, hei de comer a carne de touros ou beber o sangue de bodes?

verses.original: זְבַ֣ח לֵאלֹהִ֣ים תּוֹדָ֑ה וְשַׁלֵּ֖ם לְעֶלְי֣וֹן נְדָרֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: zə·ḇaḥ lê·lō·hîm tō·w·ḏāh wə·šal·lêm lə·‘el·yō·wn nə·ḏā·re·ḵā
verses.literal: Sacrifice a thank offering to God and fulfill your vows to the Most High
verses.literalPt: Oferece a Deus sacrifício de ação de graças e paga ao Altíssimo os teus votos.

verses.original: וּ֭קְרָאֵנִי בְּי֣וֹם צָרָ֑ה אֲ֝חַלֶּצְךָ֗ וּֽתְכַבְּדֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: ū·qə·rā·’ê·nî bə·yō·wm ṣā·rāh ’ă·ḥal·leṣ·ḵā ū·ṯə·ḵab·bə·ḏê·nî
verses.literal: Call upon Me in the day of trouble I will deliver you and you will honor Me
verses.literalPt: Invoca-me no dia da angústia. Eu te livrarei, e tu me glorificarás.

verses.original: וְלָ֤רָשָׁ֨ע׀ אָ֘מַ֤ר אֱלֹהִ֗ים מַה־ לְּ֭ךָ לְסַפֵּ֣ר חֻקָּ֑י וַתִּשָּׂ֖א בְרִיתִ֣י עֲלֵי־ פִֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·rā·šā‘ ’ā·mar ’ĕ·lō·hîm mah- lə·ḵā lə·sap·pêr ḥuq·qāy wat·tiś·śā ḇə·rî·ṯî ‘ă·lê- p̄î·ḵā
verses.literal: To the wicked, however God says What right have you to recite My statutes and to bear My covenant on your lips
verses.literalPt: Mas ao iníquo diz Deus: Que fazes tu em recitares os meus estatutos e em tomares a minha aliança na tua boca,

verses.original: וְ֭אַתָּה שָׂנֵ֣אתָ מוּסָ֑ר וַתַּשְׁלֵ֖ךְ דְּבָרַ֣י אַחֲרֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh śā·nê·ṯā mū·sār wat·taš·lêḵ də·ḇā·ray ’a·ḥă·re·ḵā
verses.literal: For you hate My instruction and cast My words behind you
verses.literalPt: visto que tu aborreces a instrução e lanças para trás das costas as minhas palavras?

verses.original: אִם־ רָאִ֣יתָ גַ֭נָּב וַתִּ֣רֶץ עִמּ֑וֹ וְעִ֖ם מְנָאֲפִ֣ים חֶלְקֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- rā·’î·ṯā ḡan·nāḇ wat·ti·reṣ ‘im·mōw wə·‘im mə·nā·’ă·p̄îm ḥel·qe·ḵā
verses.literal: When you see a thief you befriend him and throw in your lot with adulterers
verses.literalPt: Quando vias um ladrão, tu te comprazias nele e participavas com os adúlteros.

verses.original: פִּ֭יךָ שָׁלַ֣חְתָּ בְרָעָ֑ה וּ֝לְשׁוֹנְךָ֗ תַּצְמִ֥יד מִרְמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: pî·ḵā šā·laḥ·tā ḇə·rā·‘āh ū·lə·šō·wn·ḵā taṣ·mîḏ mir·māh
verses.literal: You unleash your mouth for evil and harness your tongue to deceit
verses.literalPt: Soltas a tua boca para a perversidade, e a tua língua trama enganos.

verses.transliteration: tê·šêḇ bə·’ā·ḥî·ḵā ṯə·ḏab·bêr bə·ḇen- ’im·mə·ḵā tit·ten- dō·p̄î
verses.literal: You sit and malign your brother you slander your own mother’s son
verses.literalPt: Sentado falas contra teu irmão; difamas o filho de tua mãe.

verses.original: אֵ֤לֶּה עָשִׂ֨יתָ׀ וְֽהֶחֱרַ֗שְׁתִּי דִּמִּ֗יתָ הֱֽיוֹת־ אֶֽהְיֶ֥ה כָמ֑וֹךָ אוֹכִיחֲךָ֖ וְאֶֽעֶרְכָ֣ה לְעֵינֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh ‘ā·śî·ṯā wə·he·ḥĕ·raš·tî dim·mî·ṯā hĕ·yō·wṯ- ’eh·yeh ḵā·mō·w·ḵā ’ō·w·ḵî·ḥă·ḵā wə·’e·‘er·ḵāh lə·‘ê·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: You have done these things and I kept silent you thought I was . . . just like you But now I rebuke you and accuse you to your face
verses.literalPt: Essas coisas tens feito, e calei-me; pensavas que eu me tornaria, sem dúvida, como tu. Mas eu te arguirei e te porei tudo à vista.

verses.original: בִּֽינוּ־ נָ֣א זֹ֭את שֹׁכְחֵ֣י אֱל֑וֹהַּ פֶּן־ אֶ֝טְרֹ֗ף וְאֵ֣ין מַצִּֽיל׃
verses.transliteration: bî·nū- nā zōṯ šō·ḵə·ḥê ’ĕ·lō·w·ah pen- ’eṭ·rōp̄ wə·’ên maṣ·ṣîl
verses.literal: Now consider this you who forget God lest I tear you to pieces with no one to rescue you
verses.literalPt: Considerai isso, vós que vos esqueceis de Deus, para que não vos despedace eu, sem haver quem acuda.

verses.original: זֹבֵ֥חַ תּוֹדָ֗ה יְֽכַ֫בְּדָ֥נְנִי וְשָׂ֥ם דֶּ֑רֶךְ אַ֝רְאֶ֗נּוּ בְּיֵ֣שַׁע אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: zō·ḇê·aḥ tō·w·ḏāh yə·ḵab·bə·ḏā·nə·nî wə·śām de·reḵ ’ar·’en·nū bə·yê·ša‘ ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: He who sacrifices a thank offering honors Me and to him who rightly orders his way I will show the salvation of God
verses.literalPt: Aquele que oferece o sacrifício de ação de graças me glorifica; e àquele que prepara o seu caminho, far-lhe-ei ver a salvação de Deus.
